case_name: A 10-second product ad with a closing line (the live bench's film brief)
title: Cabin Coffee, 10 s YouTube ad
tests: Tests a short ad from a one-line brief: a staged product moment, a human action, and an exact closing line on screen.

faults.what: The end-card brand name reads 'Cabin Cofee', missing an 'f' in 'Coffee'; the branding needs correction before publication.

judge.summary: A warm, visually polished coffee ad delivers the requested mug lift and closing slogan, but the brand name is misspelled.

must_haves.item: A steaming mug on a wooden table in dawn light is the opening image.
must_haves.why: The earliest supplied frame shows a steaming ceramic mug on a wooden table, backlit by a low golden sun.
The hand approaches the handle, then holds the mug raised toward the camera.

must_haves.item: The words 'Wake up slow' appear on screen at the end, spelled exactly.
must_haves.why: The closing frames clearly display 'Wake up slow'.

must_haves.item: The mood is warm and quiet (no fast cuts, no loud colours).
must_haves.why: The frames maintain a calm cabin setting with soft focus and warm brown-and-gold colours; the supplied audio information indicates a low peak level and no intelligible speech.
The clip is reported as 10 seconds, and the supplied frames are 16:9.
